episodes.title: The Case of the Missing Scrolls
episodes.summary: 1871. A wayward young Sherlock Holmes is sent to Oxford to keep out of trouble, but he soon finds himself the prime suspect in a police investigation that threatens his entire future.

episodes.title: The Case of the Burnt Photograph
episodes.summary: Sherlock is thrown into jail. He has to clear his name or face the gallows.

episodes.title: The Case of the Unarmed Man
episodes.summary: The game's afoot. With another murder and two professors missing, it's a race against time for Sherlock and Moriarty to find them before the killer does.

episodes.title: The Case of the Missing Button
episodes.summary: Sherlock returns to his childhood home in search of answers.

episodes.title: The Case of Young Sherlock Holmes
episodes.summary: Years after a tragic accident that tore the Holmes family apart, Moriarty and Sherlock come to blows as they investigate that fateful day.

episodes.title: The Case of the Killing Jar
episodes.summary: As Sherlock digs deeper into the Oxford murders, he discovers a shocking connection.

episodes.title: The Case of the Two Corners
episodes.summary: An impossible ultimatum challenges Sherlock's loyalties.

episodes.title: The Case of Beatrice Holmes
episodes.summary: Family ties and friendships are tested in the Holmes family reunion from hell.
